They appear to be in a casual conversation, looking towards the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a vertical screen view mimicking a camera interface, showing the two women posing. A white numbered overlay "3" appears at the top left, counting down. The woman in the striped shirt holds a yellow object near her ear. The background is a cluttered studio shelf with a white plush toy. (3) Back at the table, the woman in the striped shirt holds her phone up and points towards it, explaining something excitedly to her companion. Yellow and white text captions appear at the top. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (4) A screen recording sequence begins, displaying the iPhone settings menu. It navigates through 'General', 'About', and specific 'AirPods' firmware screens, showing technical details like 'iOS 26 Beta' and version numbers. (5) Returning to the live-action scene, the woman in the tank top holds an open AirPods case and asks a question. The woman in the striped shirt looks at her with a flat, unamused expression before looking back at her phone. They remain in the same indoor studio setting with the brown leather sofa visible behind them.
